resources.string: "Save" only rewrites the text and does not regenerate a reply. "Save & regenerate" deletes every message after this one and requests a new reply.
Only the text of this reply changes. Nothing is regenerated and later messages are left untouched.
One per line; generation stops when one is produced. Leave empty to send none.
"Insertion position" and "Selective" do not affect injection yet: every matched entry is appended to the system prompt. They are kept for SillyTavern card compatibility.
